text: G1 Add rrdurbar.com to Google Search Console as a domain property and verify it (DNS TXT record in the Cloudflare zone)
G2 Submit https://rrdurbar.com/sitemap.xml in Search Console
G3 Request indexing for Home, Menu, Branches, Order Now, Catering, Contact, About; use View crawled page on /about-us/ and /menu/; re-check Page indexing after a few days
G4 Search site:rrdurbar.com in Google and confirm the pages appear
G5 Open the site and confirm the analytics tool shows the visit in Realtime
G6 A verified Google Business Profile for EACH outlet (MR, SN, BH, PO, AT, PL): name, address, phone and hours identical to its branch page; photos; menu link; order link to /order-now/
G7 Link Instagram @rr_durbar (and any other profiles) in Search Console and keep them in the JSON-LD sameAs
G8 A Google review link per outlet on the site; ask the first 20 guests per outlet for a review; reply to every review
G9 Identical name, address and phone on Zomato, Swiggy, Justdial, TripAdvisor and the Instagram bio link
G10 3 or more links from Vijayawada food bloggers, local directories, catering and event directories, partners
G11 Google Alerts for "RR Durbar" and the signature dishes
G12 First posts on the site and on each Business Profile (offer, event, menu update)
G13 PageSpeed Insights and the Core Web Vitals report on the live domain; fix anything red
